name: Bloody Swarm
description:
WARNING

Not for the Weak, may cause serious rage. Very intense on high waves. Also, no sounds are included in the game. (GAME IN BETA)

KEY BINDS

WASD - Movement

Left Click - Attack (Has Sword)

Space - Jump

Shift - Sprint (Uses Stamina)

Mouse - Look

Right Click - Throw (750 Kills+)

C - Crouch Toggle

V - View Toggle

INSTRUCTIONS (IMPORTANT MECHANICS)

The main goal of the game is to survive the longest you can, even though you technically beat the game after the boss, it never really ends. You have 100 Health (At the start of the game atleast) and 100 Stamina. The game uses Kills as the main integer, higher kills mean stronger wave and enemies. Higher kills can also buff you sometimes, like getting a better sword or getting a faster sprint speed. They are also different types of enemies, Red is normal, Orange is fast and can dodge attacks, Yellow does a lot of damage, and is pretty fast, Pink does not move but has ranged attacks, Brown is the Boss (Apex Predator), and Peach is extremely fast and can teleport to the player. Some can dodge or tank hits, like Orange, Yellow, or Peach, but with certain Swords, they can be countered. They are also parkour parts in the game, which you are able to parkour on. Some are also needed for claiming a few swords, like the Summit Sword and Excalibur. Currently, they are 5 Swords/Sword Upgrades in the game.  Med kits naturally generate in the map, and when on low HP, you can claim them and heal up a bit. Crouching can also be useful as it has a 10% Dodge mechanic and can go under low surfaces. 3rd Person is highly recommended on stronger waves, as enemies have a higher chance to come from behind. Most important mechanics have been covered.

KILL CHART
